{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"卦逢生氣天德合，世世長年。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006284980266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":6,"lineType":2,"content":"注云：生氣，三合生方者為生氣。亥夘未人在亥，申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"辰人在申，巳酉丑人在巳，寅午戍人在寅，須要日時也。又云：長生亦名生氣。甲乙木到亥，丙丁火到寅，戊己土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸水到申，庚辛金到巳，此名干隂生氣也。上更帶天月德合者，尤為長夀及數世之延長耳。天德者，正丁、二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":2,"content":"坤、三壬、四辛、五乾、六甲、七癸、八艮、九丙、十乙、十一巽、十二庚。天德合者，與本命命干合，或支合帶天德合。假令己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":2,"content":"亥木人，六月甲寅日，時六月天德在甲，甲又建廟，又有天德，又有干合，世世長夀耳。假令壬子木人，四月辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":2,"content":"亥日，時四月天德在辛，木到亥長生，然無干合以應。假令丁未水人，三月壬午日、辛亥時。亥夘未生氣，三月壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854151871807530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":20,"lineType":2,"content":"為天徳合耳。假令庚午土人，己夘月，土甲申日，二月天德在坤，甲巳又合庚午土長生在申，外倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"身命","logicSentenceId":"7678981006284996650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"逢刑返尅時，必須夭賤。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006284996650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":22,"lineType":2,"content":"注云支與納音也。凡人身命日時尅破者，夭賤也。假令辛巳金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":24,"lineType":2,"content":"人，五月丙寅日，時寅刑巳下火又尅金，故為夭賤耳。假令壬申金、四月乙巳日，時乙巳火四月旺，巳又刑申，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":26,"lineType":2,"content":"禄廢之地必大敗。假令庚午土人，壬午日，時壬午自刑正月木甲，木又尅土，故應上文，外倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"四陽俱","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285013034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"立，定知難有陰尊。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285013034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":28,"lineType":2,"content":"注云陽干多而陰干少也。陽干者，甲丙戊庚壬為陽干也。若胎月日時中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":30,"lineType":2,"content":"帶陽干盛陰干孤見者，定母不夀也一。若時犯尅者，少年母死；不犯尅者，亦在二十五嵗，或中年母先死。假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":32,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子年，金，甲為陽。丙寅月，火，丙為陽。戊申日土，戊為陽。甲寅時水，甲為陽。丁巳胎土，丁為隂干也。上應四陽，俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":34,"lineType":2,"content":"立一隂尊人先主亡化也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"陰覆全逢，不見陽尊老夀。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285029418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":34,"lineType":2,"content":"注云陰干多而陽干少也。乙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854151871823914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"辛癸為陰干也。若四柱中陰盛陽衰者，定陽父不夀也。假令乙丑年，金，乙為陰也。戊寅月，土，戊為陽。丁未日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":2,"content":"水，丁為陰。癸夘時，金，癸為陰。己己胎木，己為陰。只戊寅為陽，外四陰一陽也，犯陽父先死也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"時來破","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285045802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"日音凶，而干見還輕。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285045802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":42,"lineType":2,"content":"注云凡干尅在頭面，音尅在身及四支也，故干輕音重也。假令辛巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":2,"content":"金人得丁亥日，時丁尅辛，然干尅下有土生金，見之輕耳。主先貧而後富，先賤而後貴。又須詳太常在其中無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":46,"lineType":2,"content":"氣之鄉而言之應耳。假令辛巳金人得已丑日，時已丑火尅辛巳金，納音尅重而凶耳。假令辛巳金人乙丑日、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"乙未月、丁亥時，六月土旺金印，故得丁鬼為官也。若五月乙丑日、丁亥時者為鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"患難官災，逺","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285062186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"近而自分得失，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285062186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":50,"lineType":2,"content":"詳限四柱如何吉凶。若返吟者，他州死亡凶咎。假令丁未水，人得丁丑日時，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":52,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑日，得丁未時、辛未日時，若伏吟者，在家得失。返吟者，他處吉凶。但本命日時，又得本命為伏吟。若相衝則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854151871840298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":56,"lineType":2,"content":"返吟，值本命則伏吟。本命本地吉，返吟則他鄉吉。又云：若相刑者，見旺氣尅身，則官事凶。假令戊申土，人正月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅月、甲辰日、已巳時。甲為戊之鬼，巳巳木又刑戊申土，如此則有刑鬼旺木旺刑已，身因官凶患。若死氣多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"經難，休氣多經患耳。假令庚午土，人八月庚子日土、乙夘時土，休 ist":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戊丁甲，時運戌亥，道士僧人。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285094954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":78,"lineType":2,"content":"注云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"甲丙戊也，丁多見戌亥者，道士僧人也。或曰門户出僧人也。假令甲戌人、乙亥月、丁亥日、辛亥時者是也。但甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":82,"lineType":2,"content":"丙戊重見戌亥者，應上文耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡上見，往來加臨，獄官、屠訟。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285111338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":82,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌往來，四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":84,"lineType":2,"content":"見之，為公吏、獄人、屠兒鬪訟不義之人。又云：若四柱旺，官相財得者，因不義而得也。不相得者，主不義而愚下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":86,"lineType":2,"content":"爾。又云：若旺多在辰戌者，為獄官也。相多在辰戌者，為不道之人也。死囚休廢者，為屠兒、獄吏，争訟不義之人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":88,"lineType":2,"content":"也。假令庚辰年、丙戌月、庚戌日、庚辰時，九月金相之氣所勝廢，因不義而見財也。假令庚戌年、壬辰月、壬辰日、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854151871873066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":92,"lineType":2,"content":"庚戌時者，因其氣多，則為獄訟口也。假令戊午年、壬戌月、壬辰日、庚辰時，此因氣多，則為獄訟口舌不義之道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":94,"lineType":2,"content":"耳。倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申庚甲，商路吏人。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006285127722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":94,"lineType":2,"content":"寅為功曹，主曹吏 ntent":"為丙丁多而到申酉，病死之地，主口","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":348,"lineType":2,"content":"舌生病之非。外壬癸到寅夘，則腎疾冷病。甲乙到巳午，則風肝之病。戊已到寅夘，則四肢脾病。庚辛到亥子，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":350,"lineType":2,"content":"肺寒之病。其外頗同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"子午陰陽見，盛哀兩分卦兆。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401716265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":350,"lineType":2,"content":"凡火為午，子為水，木為夘，金為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":352,"lineType":2,"content":"酉。不可盛，又不可衰。盛則太過，少則不及。凡火太過，則炎盛，盛旺中有失。水太旺，則旺中有𣴑。木太過，則折傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":354,"lineType":2,"content":"金太過，則凶。不及又不可剛，均平可言耳。假令丙子水人，癸巳月水，癸亥日水，癸亥時水，甲申水胎水多則太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":356,"lineType":2,"content":"過，太過則奔流而不定也。若不及者，絶敗之象，須要盛，盛則要鬼，衰則要生，身敗有財不困，外頗同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"南多","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401732649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"北少，家破人亡，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401732649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":358,"lineType":2,"content":"只有晝而無夜也，純陽也。假令戊辰年木，丁巳月土，已未日火，庚午時土，乃應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777531940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":362,"lineType":2,"content":"辰巳午未，陽多陰少也。外見陽多者准此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"返此之方，女男消落，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401732649","ma :null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"舍立。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401781801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":377,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚人乙日時，丙人辛日時是。但嵗干與日時干合者，自身舍居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"合分內外，取於","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401798185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777548324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"進退之方，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401798185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":381,"lineType":2,"content":"有内合外合也。假令甲人有已合，為内合也。丙辛丁壬戊癸乙庚合，非本有合者，此為外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":383,"lineType":2,"content":"合也。主本有合者，為内合也。月内合主内立，外合主外立，進退合而言之耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"畧取其强，足見","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401798185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻之勢。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401798185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"若夫在旺相之地者，夫强。妻在旺相之地者，妻强。假令庚午人乙酉日時者，夫强也。申酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"上庚旺乙敗也。若乙夘者，妻强也。假令在夘，乙旺也，倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"合逢四位，後來妻再立兒","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401814569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"郎","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401814569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"四重干合也。假令甲子人、已已月、丁夘日、壬寅時，甲已丁壬四重合也。應後妻立子外同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"隔合居","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401814569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"中妻子財門見破","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401814569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":391,"lineType":2,"content":"有合，人中有隔，其合者也。假令甲子人、庚午月、已夘日，甲為庚所隔，故應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":393,"lineType":2,"content":"上文。假令丁人先有戊，後見壬也。其外倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"造於偏地見多，而二姓三名","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401814569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":393,"lineType":2,"content":"合在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":395,"lineType":2,"content":"無力之鄉，臨破絶者是也。假令乙庚合在寅丑之地，又見戊癸合戌亥之地，但合真五行在墓絶之地者，主此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777564708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":399,"lineType":2,"content":"也。假令甲已土、乙庚金、丙辛水、戊癸火，真五行到墓絶之地，多見者應。假令甲子年、巳巳月，甲已化真土到巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":401,"lineType":2,"content":"火也。已夘日、乙丑時、庚申胎，乙庚化真金到丑上墓絶，故主二姓三名外同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"時日暗投孤兒","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401814569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"寡女，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401814569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":403,"lineType":2,"content":"主義兒女、孤兒孩也。癸巳、辛巳、壬午、甲午、丁亥、戊子，但時日見暗合者是。假令癸已日時或戊子日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360", :null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"旺鄉有鬼者，自須貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401847337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":419,"lineType":2,"content":"身如到建申之地，有官貴者，貴也。有到食者，財也。假令庚申木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":421,"lineType":2,"content":"人、丙寅日時、辛夘木人、丁夘日時、癸夘金人、丁酉日時、辛亥金人、丁巳日時。外見官見鬼，干皆要旺者也。外頗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離子午。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401863721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"丙壬重多，兒女雙生。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401880105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":423,"lineType":2,"content":"子午為隂陽之路，丙為長男，壬為中女。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":425,"lineType":2,"content":"多或丁多到寅長生，見三兩重長生者，主雙生兒。壬癸亥到申上者，主女雙生也。二三干到四位長生者，主雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"生兒女也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"時與胎連月合，必須延月。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401896489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"生時與胎月合者，主延月。假令癸夘胎，戊寅時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":429,"lineType":2,"content":"也。戊癸合或日與胎合者，非也，只言胎時應耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"辛多旺相，老婦長年。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401912873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":429,"lineType":2,"content":"六辛為太陰，太陰主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":431,"lineType":2,"content":"婦人多，而有旺相氣者，定主陰人夀長生。假令辛夘人七八月、辛巳日、辛夘時，外頗同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"金盛逢刑，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401929257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777597476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"非法亡沒。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401929257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"金為身，見三刑尅身者，定逢殺傷亡沒之灾也。假令乙未金，人得甲戌火，日時戌刑未火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"尅金，非但此例，外見有刑身尅破之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"甲逢壬癸，生於江水之中。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401945641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"一重木四重水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"也。假令一甲四壬癸也，如壬寅定於江海逝水之地生也。假令甲子年、壬申月、壬寅日、癸夘時應耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"逺泛","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401962025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401962025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"孤木柱逢多水。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401978409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"木有一支，水逢四柱，此者飄蓬也。假令巳巳年木，丙子月水，逢癸巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"日水，癸亥時水，水盛木少，無根也。飄蓬外倣此耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"辛乾巽丙，術士醫流。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006401994793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"或亥為天門為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":445,"lineType":2,"content":"天醫，辰巳為地户為地醫。丙灸醫師，乾為老陽，老陽主天門，辛為針，丙火又為灸藥，故有此為九𣴑之人也。假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰，人見戌亥上有丙辛也。或亥子人，辰巳上有丙辛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"干傷支有相刑，生人斜眼，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402011177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":449,"lineType":2,"content":"天干上尅我者，干下有相刑身者，主頭面眼目之患。假令甲辰，人得壬辰日時，或庚辰日時，但見到食鬼干無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777613860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"救者應。假令丁丑逢癸未，未刑丑，癸尅丁，外見同推耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"旺中戊已，兒孫為里內之","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402011177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402011177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":455,"lineType":2,"content":"假令六月、七月戊已多見者，主後人為鄉内之官也。若利者，富也。假令戊已多見，四月、五月見之，為財。外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙與神后休囚，隂謀争訟。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402027561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"太乙者，巳也；神后者，子也。子主陰婬，已主争訟， 人，凡有尅身多者，以此應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"金上安仁，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402158633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"門中耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402158633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":485,"lineType":2,"content":"夘酉為門户。凡夘上見上為隔，主隔塞為門户，生不遂之門。又多生小兒瘡病。假令春已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777646628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"夘日時，春土死。夘上見土，外同酉上見木，主門户小通，終有耗散耳。假令辛酉日時，又論四時不得氣者重，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"得氣者輕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"五行太過，復為怯敗之宗。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402175017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"凡太過與不及同推。假令辛未土人，庚寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"月，木再犯庚寅時。庚辛一片，旺而罕制，與弱同論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"三命復元，推之正道。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402191401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"凡三命均平者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"久長也。不犯太過、不及者也。又太過者，要降氣；不及者，要旺氣也。假令甲子人，丙寅月、戊寅日、丙辰、丁已時，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午、丙寅人，見寅若時，却得退禄者。元者本也，要干不失其氣也。假令甲乙東方，丙丁南方，戊已四季，庚申、辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"酉、壬癸亥子，皆本氣，須要均平耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"八方之卦，能推陰女盛衰，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402207785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"将八卦推婦女之象，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"乾老陽主翁父，坤老陰主婆母。艮少男，震長男，坎中男，巽長女，離中女，兊少女。八卦言之。又云凡人命犯死絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":503,"lineType":2,"content":"無氣者，定為好人家也。若有干合、支合、三合多者，定夫不真也，忌旺相多也，忌壬癸多也。得用有庚辛為富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777663012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"受禄忌馬也。假令甲以辛為夫，視其辛道辛家上見者，干在何方位也。假令甲子金人，六月辛未月為夫道，八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"月癸酉為夫家。若四柱無破夫道，夫家須旺在辛壬相之地者，定夫安老也。反此則不貴也。外者乙以庚為夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"丙以癸為夫，丁以壬為夫，戊以乙為夫，已以甲為夫，庚以丁為夫，辛以丙為夫，壬以已為夫，癸以戊為夫，皆視","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"其家道耳。八卦所尅大忌，須問尅甚也。假令壬寅日，金丑寅艮也，為長男位。乙巳時，火時尅日尅長男也。立長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"女，巽長女，外翁、婆夫、兒女同此。又云見正鬼者為偏夫，偏夫以不正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"明路九宫，更辨陽男","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402207785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"得失。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402207785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"九宫者，坎一、坤二、震三、巽四、中五、乾六、兊七、艮八、離九。将生時，上下數共合多少數，便從所得之宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":519,"lineType":2,"content":"起之。九宫者，一吉二宜，三生四殺，五鬼，六害，七傷，八難，九厄。假令甲子時，上下十八數也。甲九子九，上下　一十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"八數也。於九宫筭外，令數入九宫也。假令乙夘時，乙八夘六，六八四十八，於九宫除之，九爻漸退，有零數是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777679396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"五九四十五，外有三也。從震上起三生宫，陽人順，陰人逆也。九宫一吉，二宜，三生吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"人逢建破，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402224169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"妨害尊𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402224169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"凡有建破者，主妨害也。假令五月建庚午，日時再得午者是也。外月建同也。破者，月建相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"衝者是也，主破門離土之象，忌爾。假令五月建午，日時得子者是也，外同推之耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"癸已與乙夘，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402240553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申連戌亥，九流之士。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402240553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"癸已暗合戌宫，乙夘水昇閑水。庚申白虎守連戌亥，天門之象，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":533,"lineType":2,"content":"主出九流人，或身九流。假令癸已月、乙夘日、丙癸戌時者應耳。但三元有上文者應之耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"各推前五","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402256937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"祖宗，連後代皆知。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402256937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"凡胎前五位知祖，月前五位知父母門户，日前五位知已身弟兄妻也。時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"前五位知子孫。其位與支干如何？假令甲子年、丙寅月、已酉日、戊辰時、丁巳胎。胎前五位得壬戌，祖上隂人犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":539,"lineType":2,"content":"忌而亡也。上祖多病水氣而貧下耳。日前五位得甲寅，主自身功曹官吏立身，或多近財帛之象。時前五位得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777695780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉，應子孫，為作顛人也六癸為𤣥武，故有此應。出陪近貴人。甲到酉為暗官，於癸酉前五位取孫，得戊寅多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"孫髙耳。外倣此。迤𨓦推之落空，主絶後也。外頗同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁多或到深山，陽孤陰亂。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402273321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"寅為山，見火多，主門出陽人孤，隂人亂也。假令丙寅火人，寅長生，見火多者應耳。外同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚同㑹，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402289705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"女子娉婷。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402289705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"凡乙庚在旺相，主門户出秀麗之女也。乙未人，七月庚申日時應耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚旺相","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402306089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"之鄉，男子和明進顯。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402306089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"乙庚，真金也，在旺相之方，主男子和明進顯也。假令庚戌金人，已夘、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"乙夘日時，乙庚真金旺也。頗同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"空中有合，門生虚道閑人。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402322473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"三合、六合，干合者，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":555,"lineType":2,"content":"此也。假令庚午人、甲戌日、乙亥時。甲子自戌亥年空亡乙庚，故相合也。應上文。假令庚辰月、乙酉日時干合，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":557,"lineType":2,"content":"入空亡，外同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳與丁夘冬生，門內，官人進納。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402338857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":557,"lineType":2,"content":"六丁在月日，與壬為德合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777712164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"也。故有丁夘、丁已、丁亥，冬十月門出進納，或出身之官也。外仿此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"土居四季，見全，而多","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402355241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"有田林。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402355241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未上見土者，久立田園之兆，要不相尅也。假令甲子人，辛未月，土；丁巳日，土；辛丑時，土；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"壬戌胎水，四季土見土也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱五行定於內外，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402371625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"四分柱也。將子午夘、酉定四方也。在丑、寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"夘、辰、巳生人，以東為内，西為外；未、申、酉、戌、亥生人，西為内，東為外；午人，南為内，北為外；子人，北為内，南為外。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"法定内外立身也。假令丁夘生人，四柱在丑寅夘辰巳者，為内，在未申酉戌、亥為外。立也仿此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"命之前","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402371625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"後，陽前而陰後，五辰定見家宅禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402371625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"陽前隂後，陽命前五辰為宅，後五辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"為墓。陰命後五辰，宅前五辰墓。此法視當生年中月，上布者，干見者下，與三主相生相尅而取之，應也。假令甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":575,"lineType":2,"content":"寅水人，辛未月為宅，癸酉為墓。取大小運，取吉凶。凡視太嵗，嵗下神煞，取見入宅者，言之應也。假令甲子金人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777728548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"太嵗到辛巳金年，甲子人前五巳，巳木為宅。太嵗金，金尅木，宅也，主門户殃咎之兆耳。假令太嵗到癸未太嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"木，甲子人金，辛未土為墓，太嵗尅墓也。凡大小運同尅宅，宅内憂患。若尅墓，主墳墓憂患，言内宅外宅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402388009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"逢兄弟不相親，終見交争。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402388009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":583,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅水人，得乙丑日時者，甲乙弟兄，甲兄乙弟，弟在上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"兄在下，逆也。若乙夘者，弟兄順也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"父子、夫妻、親外，皆同前法。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402404393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"此法定尊𤰞父母、兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"弟、夫妻、兒女，其法一揆而推之。假令甲寅人，乙弟庚兒辛女，丙壻，戊父癸母，已妻。凡逆者，須與尊卑逆也。順者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"孝順也。假令甲寅人，得巳已日者，妻逆也。已建者，妻順也。父子、兄弟、上下、親類，皆仿前法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"視於日時，","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402420777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"識辨子妻。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402420777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"凡生日為妻，日小則妻小，日大則妻大也。假令甲子人丁丑日者，妻小十三嵗也。若辛酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":593,"lineType":2,"content":"日者，妻大三嵗。外同子法者，時上取三變而言之，方見生甚子也。假令甲午時，𠮓庚午、壬午也，須生金土木子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777744932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"也。外同空不言隂人同。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"胎月尊人推於父母。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402437161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"凡胎月上干音，言父母是生命之人。假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"庚戌胎月者，知父母是金土之人也。但取干音，言其親類也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"巽離旺相丙丁全，足見","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402453545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"髙門。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402453545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"巳午之地見丙丁多，門髙也。假令丁巳人丙午日時外仿此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸庚辛，土木同","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402469929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"法。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402469929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙庚辛、戊巳、壬癸旺相吉，無氣，凶兆矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝破害戊辛多，定出軍人。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402486313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"戊為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"戈，辛為金鋒之刃，故戊辛多，定出軍人。假令戊寅人辛酉月辛丑日時夘同。或門兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁，與亥未","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402502697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丁遇太常，酒家利路。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402502697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"從魁，酒神，登明，漿神，小吉，主酒食。丁巳太乙，主酒家。假令酉亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"未上見辛丁巳者，主應上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"亥逢金盛，癱患長生。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402519081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子上見金，或庚辛到亥上，主有此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":611,"lineType":2,"content":"疾也。如庚戍年金人，干支見辛亥金，金病在亥也，外頗同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"水立金中，門生陰病。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402535465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":611,"lineType":2,"content":"水到申酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777761316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":615,"lineType":2,"content":"上，主門生隂怯病耳。假令壬申金，有甲申水，外同此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"太衝辛乙無氣，而道士抽簪。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402551849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"夘酉上見辛乙相尅者應也。辛主觀，夘酉主日月之門，又主陰私在上，又主私罪耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁辛乙相","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402568233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"加，又主還俗和尚。","logicSentenceId":"7678981006402568233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉見辛夘，辛酉生也，為尼為沙門，辛為寺舍，故主耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥夘","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658761222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"上定生唇缺之人。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658761222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"乙夘木兔缺，辛反尅之，主頭面之記，或缺唇也。缺病之人，假令辛夘𣅀辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"夘時尅休氣，而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"酉上逢丁，後須絶嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658777606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"丁者，蛇也，蛇入人門。丁酉者，凶門也。酉者辛者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"立後嗣也。金為火尅，必無後嗣也，如得丁酉是矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳如生四柱，未申中三四","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658793990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"同行，必出甘泉肥夀。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658793990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"戊已土為重厚之物，如到未申長生，故應之。建旺者，門出近建有夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":629,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛向無火之鄉，不義軍人孤女。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658810374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":629,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛多或金多，不見上下火，皆門户，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777777700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"定出軍人孤女子也。假令辛未年、庚寅月、辛酉日、辛夘時、辛巳胎金鄉，多見無丙丁干也，故應上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"木多","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658826758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"繁盛空亡，而定主飄蓬。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658826758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"木主仁，多則不仁，主飄蓬散無居，立不成實之兆。甲乙多或木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"多也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣，逢金定為顯赫。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658843142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"木多或甲乙多，在有氣之地，逢庚辛或金，有貴氣之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658859526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"干五行見同上法。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658859526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"其外火多見水，水多見土，土多見木，木多見金，金多見火，上下皆同上法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸都向旺中，必須流落，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸多則散而流也，或水多亦同。若無土者，不成氣象散","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"漫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"盛則太過，少則不及，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"太多要鬼，太少要旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"四清本旺俱全，而文","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"武兩昇，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"四孟上見干旺氣者是也。假令甲寅、庚申、癸亥、丁已，皆干清旺也，主文武清貴耳。又云納音旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":647,"lineType":2,"content":"者，為濁榮也。假令庚申木、甲申水、乙巳火、丁亥土，此者納音生旺也，外同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲見之，有旺則","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777794084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"門主生貴，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"子午夘酉上見旺則以貴耳。上干下納音耳。假令癸酉金人、戊午火月、丙子水日、辛夘木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":653,"lineType":2,"content":"時，乃四柱各見納音旺耳。如乙夘、辛酉、丙午、壬子者，下也，分陰陽清濁上下言之，其外同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"季中全犯，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"有升而庫藏之官。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658875910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未上見旺氣者，主庫藏之官，尤與上法同推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"我去刑辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658892294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"必掌兵刑之任。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658892294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"上刑下是也。假令庚戌金人，逢癸未日時木，上刑下也。返此者，犯法横死之命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"須視其真假也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚旺方，外聲名","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658908678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"金。方，四角也。主聲，主有頭角，主四方之聲名也。見旺相而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":661,"lineType":2,"content":"言之。假令庚戌人，六月乙酉日時，六月乙庚金相，而土又旺，故主此耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸炎輪，多生禮","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658908678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"德。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658908678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"戊癸真火在旺相之地，主門生禮義德智耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛真化，水盛陰淫。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658925062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"真水多，則主智","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":665,"lineType":2,"content":"太盛，陰淫之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳同交，交之有信。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658941446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":665,"lineType":2,"content":"甲已真土也，主信厚而重之記耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"諸卦吉","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658957830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777810468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，視於逺近。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658957830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"旺則吉凶近，休囚則吉凶逺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"木中有土，鬼怪常聞。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658974214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"先有辛夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"木，後見巳夘土，主門户驚恐怪異之状耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"金上安仁，門中虚耗。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025658990598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"先有癸酉金，後有辛酉木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":673,"lineType":2,"content":"主虗耗在於門戸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"火加金位，孤寡貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659006982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":673,"lineType":2,"content":"火為身，到申酉之地，主耳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"炎到水鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659023366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"女人癱瘓。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659023366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"火入水中，主陰人患病耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"巽離同乾宫，出冷勞，男子","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659039750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"已午干，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁干，到戌亥者主此，應上文耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"丙壬同震，陽惑陰亂之宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659039750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"丙長男，壬長女，夘私","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"門見之，主男女不正，或甚不道。假令壬午人乙夘日時，或丙子人巳夘日時，其外仿此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"木入烟中，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659056134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"疾為小下，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659056134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"五行胎伐地也。假令戊辰木，人得已午未多也。或立為不道之士，小下之人也。外無氣破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":683,"lineType":2,"content":"同耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相休囚，問於進退，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659072518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":683,"lineType":2,"content":"在旺相者尊，有死絶者卑下與上法同耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"壬來朝甲","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659072518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777826852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"有真官，中女須榮。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659072518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬人到寅上，甲巳有合者，應上文耳。假令壬人已酉月甲寅日時，頗同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"胎月朝時建旺則祖先富貴，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659088902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"乃胎月祖門也，時日引之。建旺、建禄、建貴者，有祖道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴耳。假令已丑火胎，得壬午日時，巳禄在下，故禄發祖也。假令庚午月土，得甲申日時，庚禄在申者，門旺，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"父母力外日有則已身妻財，時子孫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"三交四聚，因官而借出其名。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659088902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"胎朝月，月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"朝日，日朝時，名倍禄也。但非本禄馬，四柱去换有禄馬者，皆居，因富貴人引薦而進耳。假令乙酉水人，甲申月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"水、丙寅日火、癸已時水。甲朝寅，丙朝巳，故借貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刑全。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659105286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"申巳寅，定有官刑嗔訟。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659121670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"寅天成，申天史，已太乙，申天馬，皆為官訟之神也。若四柱見之，主應刑獄官嗔之兆。假令寅年巳月申日時應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":701,"lineType":2,"content":"外同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"自刑，重見自死自凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659138054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":701,"lineType":2,"content":"辰午酉亥為自刑也。若更下尅上者，主自凶之兆。假令戊申土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777843236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"人，得乙酉日時，當先有官事，而後投井死也。或水病而凶。又戊辰獄刑争訟，戊午勾陳持戊，丁酉鬼火驚憂，癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"酉𤣥武得路，但依見尅身者言之。假令戊辰木人，得癸酉日時，應𤣥武鬼賊，所失外頗同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"子夘相刑，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659154438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"門無禮德。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659154438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"夘為三光之户，子為神水之元，各有勢而相刑。既見相侵，子夘見之，多無禮德之兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659170822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"逢戌，未犯支刑，肢病難痊。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659170822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"丑大吉，戌天魁，未小吉，各有金、火、木之墓毒氣，故犯者多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"有四肢，病難痊也。假令巳丑火人甲戌火月，丁未日時應上文耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"辰夘相加，必有獄刑","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659187206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"腰脚。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659187206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"夘者陰賊，辰者天罡，見者主應耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"寅來加巳，子孫憂愠燒身。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659203590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"寅，木也。巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":717,"lineType":2,"content":"火也。木入火中，故有此應也。假令甲寅水人得已巳，日，時外同此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"巳立功曹，必見尊官。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659219974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"所失","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659236358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":719,"lineType":2,"content":"寅為功曹，寅刑已，巳到寅者，受其刑也，故有應耳。假令已已人得甲寅或壬寅，日外同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"午逢","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659236358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618854235777859620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"丑位，久病內氣之災。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659236358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"午旺火，丑墓金，火金相加，故心有内氣之病耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"丑入炎陽，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659252742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"必有四肢深厄。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659252742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"丑墓金，入旺火，故主四肢深厄之患。假令辛丑人得壬午，日時外同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"子臨","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659269126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"井宿，須生脾胃之殃。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659269126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"子水到未土，土尅水，故主上也。假令丙子水人得辛未，日，時外頗同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"未到子鄉，定見尊凶婦厄。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659285510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"未，小吉也。土神子神，后主婦人，又主尊人。假令未人子丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"時應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"亥申，二勢争强。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659301894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"不爾，道路㪚失，","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659318278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"各持臨官之勢。又云，亥隂賊， "lineId":"715","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"五卦頗同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"分三辨五。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659383814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相尊名，死囚、休廢𤰞賤。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659400198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"分三者，分三主也，天地人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"三才也。辨五者，指年月日時。胎中有何喜何憂。若旺相為吉，死囚休廢為凶憂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"子來合丑，宫","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659416582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"觀閑人。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659416582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":751,"lineType":2,"content":"子為帝釋之宫，丑為雲室之房。子合丑者不順。丑合子者順也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"丑到子鄉，復為","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659432966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"真吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659432966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":753,"lineType":2,"content":"丑人合子順，子合丑不順。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"亥朝寅位，滋養外人。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659449350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":753,"lineType":2,"content":"亥者，無氣之水。寅者，天梁之木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":755,"lineType":2,"content":"亥必奔流，木必有根。故亥合寅不順。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"寅入天宫，顯然 Yin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":765,"lineType":2,"content":"巳刑申，巳，火刑申，金上尅下，故順刑道路長行之兆耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"申到","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659564038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中，行人返復。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659564038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":767,"lineType":2,"content":"申金人，巳火逆也。故行人返復也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"未午合分得失。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659580422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"未吉","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659596806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"午凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659596806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"未土逢火生，吉。午火逢未土凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"細視陰陽，居分得失。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659613190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":769,"lineType":2,"content":"何先何後，何吉何凶，細視","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"之。三元下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"全逢下尅四親孤。","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659629574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"尤忌二尊","logicSentenceId":"7678982025659645958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"攴尅干也。假令癸未木、壬戌月、庚午日、巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":773,"lineType":2,"content":"夘時、癸丑胎，皆下尅上，主四親
